name: Tooltip
intent: Brief label or hint shown on hover/focus to name an icon or clarify a terse control.
when: An icon-only button needs a name
A truncated or terse control needs a short explanation

chooseOver.because: HoverCard is for richer preview content; Tooltip is a short text label
Popover holds interactive content on click; Tooltip is non-interactive hover text

commonMistakes.mistake: Put interactive content in a tooltip
commonMistakes.fix: Use Popover or HoverCard (see fm-prim-2 for the TooltipProvider rule)
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Put interactive content in a tooltip — use Popover or HoverCard (see fm-prim-2 for the TooltipProvider rule)
